card.name: Qualifier after single, multiple, low
card.fires_on: A describing word right after a quantity or size word such as single, multiple, low, 2 or given, mostly 'oral', 'doses' or '-dimensional'. It appears in pharmacokinetic text and in physics or materials text.

modes.label: Dose wording after single/multiple
modes.description: The word oral, dose or doses follows single, multiple or given in drug interaction text.

modes.label: Dimension or direction terms
modes.description: A suffix or adverb such as -dimensional, -D, ically or horizontally follows a number or a shape word in science text.
